Reference revision: 2709726934f0a02ceacdb7ee07d17785c344d244

The repository README explicitly specifies the MIT License. DnDRom adapts the
particle motion, discharge/momentum tracking and sediment cascade algorithms
in source/water.h and source/world.h. No example artwork or textures are used.
Adaptations: physical cell units, finite-difference gradients, explicit sediment
mass and boundary export accounting, bounded local incision, seeded randomness.
